test.create_query: CREATE TABLE text_index_pattern_bypass_cache ( part UInt8, id UInt64, message String, INDEX idx(message) TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha, dictionary_block_size = 64) ) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY part ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO text_index_pattern_bypass_cache SELECT number % 64, number, concat( 'p', char(97 + intDiv(number, 64) % 26), char(97 + intDiv(intDiv(number, 64), 26) % 26)) FROM numbers(64 * 676 * 7)
